body:
# submission name:

henosis_frontier

# upload zipped `archive.zip`

[archive.zip](https://github.com/henosis-us/comma_video_compression_challenge/releases/download/henosis-frontier-v1/archive.zip)

# report.txt

```txt
=== Evaluation config ===
  batch_size: 16
  device: cuda
  num_threads: 2
  prefetch_queue_depth: 4
  report: submissions/henosis_frontier/report.txt
  seed: 1234
  submission_dir: submissions/henosis_frontier
  uncompressed_dir: videos
  video_names_file: public_test_video_names.txt
=== Evaluation results over 600 samples ===
  Average PoseNet Distortion: 0.00018940
  Average SegNet Distortion: 0.00057182
  Submission file size: 296,789 bytes
  Original uncompressed size: 37,545,489 bytes
  Compression Rate: 0.00790478
  Final score: 100*segnet_dist + sqrt(10*posenet_dist) + 25*rate = 0.30
```

# does your submission require gpu for evaluation (inflation)?

yes

# did you include the compression script? and want it to be merged?

no

# additional comments

CUDA/GPU inflation is required. Locally validated with Linux CUDA/DALI; rounded score is `0.30`.

comments.body:
Thanks for the submission @henosis-us! 🤏

A maintainer will review your PR shortly.

To run the evaluation, a maintainer will trigger the `eval` workflow with your PR number.

Closing this submission after discovering our local comparison harness had diverged from the repo evaluator. Rechecking with the official current repo CUDA evaluator shows this submission is not competitive, so I'm withdrawing it to avoid leaving inaccurate numbers around.

title: henosis_frontier (0.30)
